description: A figure region (here a text stand-in for an image, since this corpus can't encode real raster content) followed by its caption, with a synthetic `graphics` Image entry over the figure's bbox standing in for a real embedded raster. The caption's own heuristic (is_caption) already recognizes the 'Figure N' prefix correctly; the figure region itself is now detected by graphics::detect_picture_regions (Stage 1b) from the Image graphic, not a vision model. Associating the caption with *which* picture (when multiple figures share a page) is still open -- see figure_caption-multiple-figures-share-a-page.
